title: File system access
description: Inventory of every file-system touchpoint of the solution, classified by operation and API group, with drilldown to the call site. Covers native FileMaker commands (Data File API, Import/Insert, Export/Save — Step_ID-gated, locale-independent) and MBS plugin functions (Files / Text / Container / Path / Folders / FileDialog, resolved via calls_pluginfunction links). Network access stays in the APIs dashboard. Extend the WHEN branches for project-specific MBS components.
author: fm-lab

params.name: file
params.description: Optional file filter (from the app-level filter).

params.name: operation
params.description: Restricts the detail list to an operation (read/write/delete/probe/import/export/launch/mount/dialog/path/manage). 'All' (or empty) lifts the filter.

params.name: api_group
params.description: Restricts the detail list to an API group (Data File API / Import/Insert / Export/Save / MBS Files / MBS Text / …). 'All' (or empty) lifts the filter.

params.name: ref_type
params.description: Restricts the detail list to a reference type ('Native Step', 'MBS Script', 'MBS CustomFunction', …). 'All' (or empty) lifts the filter.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of rows returned by the detail lists.
